objective: Synthetic Mission 4 shape: a messaging mission whose packet names sixteen completion criteria and eight workflows, so the walker contract has something to be complete about.
non_goals: No real Linear issue is created or updated
No real pull request is opened or merged
No production, hosted-Supabase, or external-service effect of any kind

requirements.text: Synthetic: operators can filter the events list by state.
Synthetic: attendance summaries export as CSV.
Synthetic: the Monday report shows a generation footer.

decisions.text: Synthetic decision: CSV exports use comma separators.

completion_evidence: An approver can read the messaging plan for an event before anything is sent
The club's messaging schedule shows what is queued and when it runs
A player receives an answer link by WhatsApp and by email
The answer link records exactly one answer without a login
A link scanner's prefetch never consumes the answer
Reloading an answered link neither errors nor double-answers
A player's own page shows what they have been asked and what they answered
An operator can record an in-person answer on a player's behalf
The attendance view shows who is coming and who has not answered
The chase list shows only the people who still owe an answer
A failed delivery is visible as failed, with its reason
A repaired delivery is re-sent and recorded as repaired
A held job resumes without duplicating anything already sent
The queue reports honestly when a provider is unavailable
No message reaches a real recipient from the local transport seam
Every delivery row names the synthetic identity it was addressed to

repository_drift.startup_rule: Compare current main with the synthetic baseline.
repository_drift.stop_rule: Stop when drift changes the synthetic contract.

approval.evidence: Synthetic fixture approval — rehearsals only, never a real mission
